min_standing_note.notes: No incoming-exchange standing note verified in Oberlin brochure or oberlin.edu.

excluded_majors.notes: Undergraduate-only institution (no graduate students, Oberlin brochure p.6); Conservatory of Music applied degree entry requires separate audition/application.

min_gpa_host.notes: No published minimum numeric GPA cutoff found for incoming non-degree exchange students on oberlin.edu (degree HS stats excluded).

english_course_availability.notes: US liberal arts college; all instruction in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test required for non-native English speakers unless prior education was conducted entirely in English (waivers also requestable via admissions); no fixed numeric cutoff stated.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Semester: Classes begin Aug 26, 2026 (Int'l F-1/J-1 Pre-Orientation move-in Aug 17, 2026); exact Fall 2026 end date via https://www.oberlin.edu/arts-and-sciences/registrar/academic-calendar.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Semester: Classes Feb 1 - May 7, 2027; Spring Break Mar 20-28; Reading May 8-11; Final Exams May 12-16, 2027 (Commencement May 24, 2027).

tuition_model.notes: No explicit incoming bilateral exchange tuition-waiver policy verified publicly on oberlin.edu (posted sticker tuition ~$68,340-$70,320 applies to degree billing).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly room & board from Oberlin 2025-26 baseline charges (Room $9,970+ and 7-day Board $10,126+ = $20,096/9-mo academic year -> $2,232.89/mo, rounded to $2,233/mo; or $10,048/sem). Excludes mandatory fees (~$1,092+/yr), non-waivable 2026-27 health insurance ($3,028/yr), books, and personal expenses.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly USD range 2,233/month. No FX conversion (1 USD = 1.0 USD; 5-month equivalent = 5 * 2,233.0 USD = 11,165.00 USD), calculated 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: 2026-27 Anthem/Academic HealthPlans student health insurance is mandatory and non-waivable for F-1/J-1 international students at $3,028/year (Aug 1, 2026 - Jul 31, 2027); standard mandatory fees ~$1,092+/yr (2025-26 baseline).

housing_availability.notes: Residential campus housing and meal plans coordinated via Residence Life/OSCA; F-1/J-1 arrival move-in begins Aug 17, 2026.

housing_notes.value: 2025-26 baseline Room ~$9,970+/yr and 7-day meal plan ~$10,126+/yr; OSCA dining/housing cooperatives also exist.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Need-based aid applies to degree applicants; no incoming exchange stipend verified.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Incoming international exchange students require J-1 DS-2019 (or F-1 I-20) issued via International Student Resource Center / ISSS with financial support documentation; mandatory Pre-Orientation check-in Aug 17, 2026.

exchange_page_url.notes: See also Study Away Office at https://www.oberlin.edu/study-away.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in https://catalog.oberlin.edu are taught in English; no separate English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.notes: US semester credits; exact incoming exchange min/max credit limits not verified on oberlin.edu.

course_restrictions_note.value: Conservatory of Music applied studios/auditioned courses require audition/permission; undergraduate-only college (no graduate courses).

required_application_docs.notes: Coordinated directly via partner exchange nomination / non-degree admissions; checklist not publicly posted on oberlin.edu.

academic_style.value: Undergraduate-only residential liberal arts college + conservatory (~2,900 students, 9:1 student-faculty ratio, 80% of classes <20 students, one-on-one undergraduate faculty research).

city_tier.notes: oberlin.edu explicitly characterizes Oberlin, Ohio (~8,600 residents, 35 miles SW of Cleveland) as a quintessential college town.

campus_type.notes: Brochure p.8 describes Oberlin as a 'small town' 35 miles SW of Cleveland without specifying 'rural' vs 'suburban' classification.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated on oberlin.edu or brochure (US English-speaking campus).

international_support_services.value: International Student Resource Center (ISRC/ISSS), F-1/J-1 Pre-Orientation, Residence Life, Allen Memorial Art Museum (free), Winter Term mentorship.

nomination_deadlines.notes: Note: Nov 1 / Jan 5 / Jan 15 dates on oberlin.edu are degree admission deadlines and Mar 15 / Oct 15 on Study Away apply to outgoing study away; incoming partner exchange deadlines not publicly published.
